# DSH Studio v0.9.7-plus1

First release of **dsh-studio-plus**, a fork of Moresyl/dsh-studio that tracks current Harness releases instead of pinning one.

## Fixed and added
- Harness 0.1.2 support: the runtime contract targets `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.2-rc.1, and the Studio integration follows the new workspace architecture (`dsh-api-workspace-controller`, `dsh-client-ui-workspace`).
- The 0.1.2 browser-session fence is qualified at install time: a Studio-launched harness (`DSH_DESKTOP`) treats loopback callers as authenticated, while a terminal-launched `dsh` keeps upstream's launch-token fence untouched.
- The pinned release became a channel: Settings → Harness runtime lists every published dsh release, flags updates, preflights the switch against Studio's install-time patches, and degrades gracefully when an optional patch no longer applies.
- Merged upstream 0.9.3 through 0.9.7 (Node 24 CI actions, refreshed Tauri plugins, reworked onboarding docs).

## Verification
- Passed frontend (267), Rust (379), and contract test suites on macOS universal builds.
- Preflight verified against dsh 0.1.5-rc.1: all eleven patch anchors match.
- macOS and Windows builds ship unsigned for now: on first launch macOS requires right-click → Open, and Windows shows a SmartScreen prompt.
